cases.prompt: The client approved our proposal for the Apigee migration (attached, v2.3) and the estimate (attached). Commercial model: fixed price per wave, 4 waves. MSA reference: MSA-2024-117. Draft the SOW.
expected: Scope statements numbered S-nn with verb, object, boundary, and appendix references; mirrored O-nn out-of-scope items
Deliverables table has objective acceptance criteria, method, review window, approver, milestone; deemed-acceptance clause present
Milestones tied to accepted deliverables; amounts from the proposal pricing or [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]
Every estimate quantity appears as an assumption with consequence if false and change-control trigger = Y
Client dependencies have dates and delay consequences
RACI has exactly one A per row
Legal topics listed with MSA clause references marked 'confirm with counsel', not drafted
Internal traceability table and scope-ambiguity register produced separately
